text: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Submit the order number to support. Digital subscriptions are refunded only for unused periods.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 business day. Tracking numbers arrive by email after dispatch.
API keys must remain on the server. Rotate exposed credentials immediately. Never commit secrets to GitHub.
A useful bug report includes reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, browser version and screenshots. Remove private user data before sharing logs.
